c.intro: Each host detects and enforces bans locally, including while the private controller is unreachable. The hub exchanges changes after reconnection; it is not the local protection engine.
c.aboutSources: Hybrid detection combines application authentication events with log detection. Registering a source does not install an application hook or adapter. Available sources depend on local modules and their integration.
c.aboutCloud: The CrowdSec Central API, community blocklist and console enrollment are always disabled.
c.timeout: The task did not finish in time
c.roleHelp: Install one instance on each host. Every instance has its own local CrowdSec API and firewall protection. The hub also runs the private controller; members synchronize with it.
c.roleFixed: The role cannot be changed after setup. Install a new instance to change it.
c.hubHost: Public host name of the hub
c.hubHostHelp: Point this DNS name to this node. Members connect to https://<host>/; NS8 Traefik provides HTTPS.
c.tokenHelp: Create a csc2 membership token on the hub under Members and paste it here. This is not an event-source token.
c.tokenKeep: Leave empty to keep the current connection.
c.banDurationHelp: Duration for new local bans, for example 30m or 4h.
c.allowlistHelp: IP addresses and networks excluded from bans on this node, one per line. This is not a global allowlist.
c.communityBlocklistHelp: Opt-in. This node registers with the CrowdSec Central API (api.crowdsec.net) and downloads a list of about 15,000 IP addresses that other CrowdSec users have reported, then blocks them like local bans. Needs internet access; without it the module stays fully offline. Entries from this list are never forwarded to other Guardian nodes: enable it on each node that should use it. Switching it off removes the imported entries again.
c.communitySharing: Also share signals about attacks on this node
c.communitySharingHelp: Sends the attacker address, time and detection rule of local detections to CrowdSec, no log contents. CrowdSec delivers a larger blocklist to nodes that share.
c.communityError: Community blocklist registration failed (will retry hourly):
c.sambaAuditHelp: Raises Samba's JSON authentication audit level in the running Samba process of this node. The saved Samba configuration is not changed.
c.membersHelp: Membership tokens authorize controller synchronization, not remote CrowdSec LAPI access. Local protection continues without the hub. Offline members receive central changes after reconnecting.
c.hubOnly: This page is available on the hub only.
c.memberNameHelp: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes, for example the host name.
c.tokenOnceHelp: It is shown only once. Paste it into the member's settings.
c.name: Name
c.confirmRemove: Remove member {name}? Controller access is revoked; this does not disable its local protection.
c.bansHelp: Local ban view on this node, including synchronized decisions. Unban is available on both roles. Central changes reach offline nodes after reconnection; no fixed delivery time is guaranteed.
c.notConfigured: The module is not configured yet.

err.invalid_duration: Use minutes or hours, for example 30m or 4h
err.invalid_address: Enter IP addresses or networks only
err.invalid_member_name: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes
err.member_exists: A member with this name already exists
err.invalid_source_name: Use lowercase letters, digits and dashes
err.invalid_module: Enter a valid local module identity

c.syncIdle: No pending changes reported (not a connectivity check)
c.syncOverload: Synchronization capacity reached; some changes are deferred. Check controller and local capacity, then refresh. An empty outgoing queue does not mean synchronization is complete.
c.syncStale: Synchronization status is stale; controller contact is not confirmed
c.unackedEvents: Events not yet acknowledged by the engine
c.ackWaiting: waiting for the engine to read them
c.tlsRequired: Controller TLS certificate verification is mandatory. Use a certificate trusted by this node.
c.eventSourcesHelp: Register an application identity on this node for authentication events. Provisioning only creates credentials: the application must have a real hook or a separately installed structured-log adapter.
c.moduleIdentityHelp: Exact local module identity, for example gitea1 or vaultwarden1. Register only when its event producer is ready.
c.sourceTokenOnce: Shown only now. Save it securely for the event producer. It is cleared on refresh, removal, navigation or reload.
c.sourceTokenScope: This token authorizes this source only. It is not a membership token or a CrowdSec LAPI credential. Do not put it in a URL or logs.
c.sourcePendingRecovery: Provisioning did not complete. Remove this pending source, then recreate it and securely save the new token. Pending sources cannot send events and do not disable fallback login detection.
c.sourceActive: Active registration (not proof of event delivery)
c.confirmRemoveSource: Remove event source {name} and revoke its bearer token?
c.hookGuide: Actual application hook: report only authentication_failed events from a trustworthy authentication result, using the original event ID, UTC time and real client IP. The source token determines the module identity. Registration does not install hooks in Gitea, Vaultwarden or other apps.
c.adapterGuide: Structured-log adapter: if no hook exists, run a separate trusted adapter that reads the app’s structured authentication audit logs and sends equivalent events. Verify failure semantics and client IP handling first; an HTTP status alone is not proof of a failed login.
c.fallbackGuide: For a module with an active registration, fallback login detection from proxy logs is disabled to avoid duplicates; pending registrations do not disable it. Generic HTTP scanner detection works on the Traefik access log only, not on this event path, and this module is not a WAF. Connect and verify the producer before relying on this path; registration is not evidence that events are arriving.
